subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should the remaining work stay in this umbrella issue or split into status-diagnostics and skill prompt-rewrite warning follow-ups, and which operator-visible surface should carry the prompt-rewrite warning?
rationale: Source inspection shows two real remaining improvements, but the prompt-rewrite warning surface is a product choice and the current issue bundles multiple operator surfaces.

options.title: Split And Keep Both
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics and the prompt-rewrite warning as separate focused follow-ups, then close this umbrella after links exist.

options.title: Implement Both Here
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical work item until one change covers status text/JSON/all diagnostics plus the chosen prompt-rewrite diagnostic.

options.title: Status Only
options.body: Proceed with registry diagnostics in status and explicitly decline or defer the prompt-rewrite warning if it would be too noisy.

recommendation.title: Split And Keep Both
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics and the prompt-rewrite warning as separate focused follow-ups, then close this umbrella after links exist.

likelyOwner.reason: They already gave the maintainer-context review on this issue and are the clearest routing owner for the product-shape decision.
